plainText:
Iris's Gible (Japanese: アイリスのフカマル Iris's Fukamaru) was the only that in the Johto region, and her fifth overall.

==History==
=== ===
 
Iris first encountered Gible when she entered Blackthorn City in BWS02. The had been biting city property, causing significant damage. The local citizens chased him out of town after biting into another building, but Iris stepped in to defend him, giving him a chance to escape.

Gible remained in Blackthorn and climbed up a clock tower to get a better view of the city. However, a large gust of wind caused Gible to fall, and he barely managed to hang on to one of the clock's arms. Iris determinedly ascended the clock tower and was able to save him despite the danger that she and Gible could both fall off. Afterward, Iris read Gible's memories and discovered that he had been sleeping on a tree and accidentally fallen onto a . This startled the Armor Bird Pokémon, and it flew away, eventually dropping Gible into the city. Gible had become confused with his new surroundings, which were very different from his previous peaceful habitat. Iris soon met with Clair, and the two of them took Gible to the Dragon Holy Land so he could live in nature once again.

Gible did not remain at the Dragon's Den for long. When Iris had her with Clair, Gible his way into the to watch the match. After the battle, when Iris was leaving, Gible appeared once again. Iris then understood that Gible wanted to go with her and caught him with a . After he was caught, Gible and his new saw the Legendary Pokémon flying across the sky and decided to follow it.

=== ===
Gible appeared in Thrash of the Titans! during a fantasy sequence of Iris's .

==Personality and characteristics==
Similar to Ash's Gible, he has a habit of biting individuals on the head, particularly Iris's Axew. Gible seems to be a bit oblivious, ignoring everything going on around him and simply doing as he pleases. He is also quite destructive, destroying an area of Blackthorn City with just his teeth and attack.

==Moves used==
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Gible is the first Pokémon to be caught by a main character in a special episode.
Gible is the only one of Iris's Pokémon:
That has never been physically seen in the or English dub. 
Who isn't fully evolved.
That was obtained outside of Unova.
has never seen.
Gible is the first Pokémon one of Ash's friends owns to be the same species as one he owns that isn't a first partner Pokémon.
